en-gb.text: Enjoy access to our facilities at any time, but you’ll miss out on access to racquets, exclusive spa facilities and Blaze classes.

de-de.text: Sie haben jederzeit Zugang zum Club, allerdings enthält Ihre Mitgliedschaft kein Tennis, so wie keinen Zugang zum traumhaften Spa-Bereich und den beliebten BLAZE Kursen.

nl-be.text: Geniet op elk moment van toegang tot onze faciliteiten, maar je mist de toegang tot rackets, exclusieve spafaciliteiten en Blaze-lessen.

fr-be.text: Profitez de l'accès à nos installations à tout moment, mais vous ne pourrez pas accéder aux raquettes, aux installations exclusives du spa et aux cours Blaze.

ca.text: Gaudeix d'accés a les notres instal·lacions en qualsevol horari, però no podràs fer servir les pistes, l'exclusiu spa i les classes de Blaze.

it-it.text: Puoi accedere a tutte le strutture in qualunque momento, esclusi i campi da tennis e padel, la spa e i corsi di Blaze

en-gb.name: Half Price Joining Fee plus 3 Personal Training Sessions
en-gb.rateCardBannerTitle: Reduced joining fee on selected memberships, plus 3 personal training sessions included to help you get started.
en-gb.rateCardBannerDescription: when joining on a selected standard 12 month memberships. Joining fee includes 3 Personal Training sessions. A Personal Training  session lasts 45 minutes and typically retails at £35 per session.

Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult.
Offer is not transferable between clubs.
Offer of half price joining fee is only applicable when joining on a 12 month standard packages.
Certain membership packages will be excluded from this offer.

This offer cannot be used in conjunction with any other offer.

You use the facilities at your own risk.
We recommend getting medical advice before doing any physical activity.
Facilities, fees, classes and membership contracts vary by club.
Management reserves the right to withdraw the offer at any time.
Personal Training sessions are non-refundable and can’t be exchanged or swapped
Personal Training sessions must be booked and taken within 4 weeks of joining.
Personal Training sessions are subject to availability and will need to be taken at your home club
